behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'sales' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'support' arm ends at Fast-Track 'support' + Alert, which sends a Telegram message. The 'sales' arm goes to Delegate 'sales' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Sales Email - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Sales Email before relying on that arm.

behaviour.detail: "ONCALL_NUMBER" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

behaviour.title: Set a real fallback for the placeholder expressions
behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.
